user.title: Mega Home
user.description: Paste the setup key from Mega Manager. It looks like https://manager.example.com#abc123 — the manager address, a # sign, then the object's token.

data.manager_url: Manager address (only if the key is a bare token)

data_description.key: The whole key as the manager shows it. A bare token without an address also works — then fill in the manager address below.
data_description.manager_url: For example http://manager.example.com:8055 — the inbound port, not the interface port.

reconfigure.title: Mega Home
reconfigure.description: Change the setup key (manager address and object token). The object keeps its history and entities.

data.manager_url: Manager address (only if the key is a bare token)

data_description.key: The whole key as the manager shows it: address, a # sign, token.
data_description.manager_url: For example http://manager.example.com:8055 — the inbound port, not the interface port.
data_description.music_admin_token: A Music Assistant administrator access token for connecting Yandex Music and speakers. Leave blank to keep the current token.

error.cannot_connect: The manager did not answer. Check the address, the port and that the object can reach it.
error.invalid_key: The key is not complete: it needs the manager address and the token. Paste it whole, or fill in the address.
error.invalid_url: The address must start with http:// or https://.

abort.already_configured: This object is already set up.

sync.name: Synchronise now
sync.description: Fetch the home configuration from Mega Manager without waiting for the next poll.

calibrate_position.name: Calibrate blind position
calibrate_position.description: Tell a pulse-relay blind where it actually is, without moving it.

position.name: Position
position.description: Actual position, 0 is closed and 100 is open.
